result:
All four answers come from reading the repo. I ran no build or server. I skipped `web/.next` and `node_modules` as told, except for lockfile metadata. This copy isn't a git repo, so anything relying on `git ls-files` (`build-runtime.mjs:71`) is unchecked.

## 1. What can go, what must stay

**Browser UI only, safe to delete**
- `web/app/page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `globals.css` and `icon.svg`.
- All 19 files in `web/components/`.
- `web/lib/use-shell.ts` and `web/lib/use-agent-thread.ts`. Only `page.tsx:28-29` imports them.
- `web/postcss.config.mjs`.
- `web/public/**`. Only `layout.tsx:9-15`, `bot-avatar.tsx:20` and `useful-bot-logo.tsx:5` use it. See section 2 before deleting it.
- Nothing under `web/app/api`, `web/app/eve` or `web/lib` imports from `components/` or `page.tsx`, so nothing cascades.

**Must stay**
- Every `web/app/api/**/route.ts` and `web/app/eve/v1/[...path]/route.ts`.
- The macOS app calls these paths from `BackendClient.swift`:
  - `api/agent/*`, `api/approvals`, `api/attachments`, `api/auth/session`
  - `api/connections/widget`, `api/connectors` and `api/connectors/own-app`
  - `api/health`, `api/memory`, `api/providers`, `api/providers/oauth`
  - `api/routines`, `api/shell`, `api/status`, `api/usage`, `api/workspace`
  - `eve/v1/session…` (lines 1136, 1365, 1901)
- iOS uses the same client.
- `api/connections/callback` and `api/connectors/callback` are OAuth landing pages. `shell/route.ts:136,142` builds their URLs.
- `api/reviewer` has no caller in the tree, but `service.mjs:236-239` still provisions its token. It isn't UI, so it's your call.
- All of `web/lib/*` except the two hooks. Tests import `agent-exec`, `api-guard`, `auth`, `ingress`, `media-migrate`, `image-regenerate` and `sync-models`.
- `web/next.config.ts` and `web/tsconfig.json`.
- `GET /api/auth/session` stays too. The browser used it, but the macOS client also calls it (`BackendClient.swift:470,492`).
- Dead but not in `web/`:
  - `shared/chat-markdown.ts` has only the UI and `test/chat-markdown.test.ts` as importers.
  - `withoutLeadingThink` in `shared/inline-think.ts` is used by `page.tsx:27` and `test/inline-think.test.ts:12`. The file itself stays, since `router/src/inline-think.ts:14` uses it.

## 2. What breaks or needs changing

- **`macos/build-app.sh:27`** runs `cp -R web/public …` under `set -eu`. If `web/public` is gone, `build:app` aborts. An empty folder won't help, because git doesn't track empty directories.
- **`scripts/web-mode.mjs:74`** requires `standalone/web/public` and `standalone/web/.next/static`. In a release, a missing one throws "release runtime has no complete web build" (`:77`). In a checkout it falls back to `next dev` (`:82`). Drop `public` from that list and from `build-app.sh:25-27` together. Confirm `.next/static` is still emitted with no pages.
- **`test/web-mode.test.ts:22,58`** encode the `public` requirement. The tests use temp roots, so they pass until `web-mode.mjs` changes, then need updating.
- **Source fingerprint (`web-mode.mjs:10,14`)** changes when files are deleted. Missing paths are harmless (`:26-27`). Every existing build goes stale and the launcher runs `next dev` until `build:app` runs again.
- **Brand pipeline:**
  - `build-brand-assets.mjs:208,238,358,360` writes `web/app/icon.svg` and `web/public/*`. `brand:build` would recreate the deleted files.
  - `check-brand-assets.mjs:30,144,208` requires them, so `brand:check` fails.
  - `brand/asset-manifest.json:1052-1212`, `brand/README.md:54-70` and `BRAND_ASSET_REPORT.md` also list them.
- **`verify-release.mjs:78`** (`tsc_web`) still works with zero TSX. Re-run it after removing `@types/react`.
- **Next build:** the docs I pulled call a root layout required for pages. I couldn't confirm that a route-handlers-only tree builds without one. One `build:app` will show it. If Next complains, keep a bare `layout.tsx`.
- **Side benefit:** `layout.tsx:2` fetches Geist Mono from Google at build time, and that goes away.
- **`GET /` will 404.** Nothing in the tree polls it. Health is `api/health` (`ServerConfig.swift:43`).
- **Stale comments and docs** (no build effect):
  - `CLAUDE.md` surface #3
  - `README.md:189`
  - `HANDOFF.md:90-93`
  - About 12 Swift comments naming `web/components/*.tsx` or `globals.css` as the token source (for example `DesignTokens.swift:3,91`)

## 3. Packaged release

**After the change it should still start**, if the section 2 edits are made.
- `build-runtime.mjs:40-50` ships no web sources. It copies the whole `web/.next/standalone` (`:80`) and runs `npm ci --omit=dev` (`:94`).
- It then deletes root `node_modules/next` and `@next` (`:108`).
- `service.mjs:242-253` runs `<runtime>/web/.next/standalone/web/server.js` with `HOSTNAME` and `PORT` set.

**Module resolution**
- `outputFileTracingRoot` is the repo root (`next.config.ts:18`). Next writes the app under `standalone/web/` and traced dependencies under `standalone/node_modules/`.
- `next` resolves from `standalone/node_modules`, so deleting the root copy is safe.
- Any untraced package (zod, ai, eve, just-bash, @composio/core) falls through the parent walk to `<runtime>/node_modules`, which `npm ci` populated.
- Deleting the UI only shrinks the traced set. `next`, `react` and `react-dom` must stay installed.

**Does it start today?** By config, yes. I can't confirm the packaged path without running it. There's one risk that has nothing to do with this change. Root `package.json:2` is `"type": "module"` and Next is 16.2.1 (`package.json:38`). Next's docs say its `{"type":"commonjs"}` boundary for `.next/server` was only carried into standalone output in v16.2.7. On 16.2.1, check that `web/.next/standalone/web/.next/package.json` exists. I didn't look, as instructed. If it's missing, the fix is bumping Next, and that rewrites the lockfile (finding 3).

## 4. Dependencies

- **Unused after deletion:** `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss` (only `globals.css:1` and `postcss.config.mjs:3`), `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom`. No `.tsx` remains anywhere else.
- **Keep:**
  - `next`: 30 route files import `next/server`.
  - `react` and `react-dom`: non-optional peers of `next` in the lockfile. An unused-dependency tool will flag them wrongly.
  - Everything else is used by `agent/`, `shared/` or `router/`.
- **Must change with the removal:** `npm uninstall` rewrites `package-lock.json`. `router/src/registry.ts:80-88` then refuses to boot with 503 `configuration_unverified`. Both `packageLockHash` values (`shared/registry.json:23,46`) must be updated. They currently equal the lockfile's sha256, `e82e2b98…7356`.

## Findings

1. Delete `page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `globals.css`, `icon.svg`, all 19 components, both hooks, `postcss.config.mjs` and `web/public/**`. Nothing in the API, `lib` or tests imports them.
2. Keep every route and every other `web/lib` file. The macOS and iOS clients, the OAuth redirects and the tests use them.
3. Highest risk: removing dependencies changes the lockfile hash and the router refuses to start. Re-stamp `shared/registry.json:23,46` and update `HANDOFF.md:93`. Consider whether the S1 live gate (`shared/registry.json:21`) needs re-running.
4. `web/public` is hard-wired into `build-app.sh:27`, `web-mode.mjs:74` and `test/web-mode.test.ts:22,58`. Change all three together.
5. `brand:build` and `brand:check` must stop referencing `web/public` and `web/app/icon.svg`. Otherwise the first regenerates the deleted files and the second fails.
6. Remove `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@types/react` and `@types/react-dom`. Keep `next`, `react` and `react-dom`.
7. The release path should still start after the change. I couldn't confirm it starts today, because of the `type: module` and Next 16.2.1 question.
8. Confirm with one `build:app` that a route-only tree builds without a layout and still emits `.next/static`.
9. Clean up `shared/chat-markdown.ts` plus its test in `npm test`, `withoutLeadingThink`, and the doc and comment references. The perf guard isn't affected until launch (`CLAUDE.md`).
